candidates.explanation: The stored path is built as `/${apiPrefix}/v1/${file.filename}`, which leaves out the `files` segment. The download route is `GET {apiPrefix}/v1/files/:path`, set by `@Controller({path:'files', version:'1'})`. The saved and returned link is therefore `/api/v1/<filename>`, which matches no route and returns 404 even though the file is on disk.

fix.description: Include the `files` segment in the stored path: `/${apiPrefix}/v1/files/${file.filename}`.
